text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to install a "No Parking Anytime" regulation on the north and east side of Beaumonde Heights Drive between, Islington Avenue and Monterrey Drive, to improve motorist safety in the area. The proposed parking amendment is in consultation with the ward Councillor.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the north and east side of Beaumonde Heights Drive, between Islington Avenue and Monterrey Drive.
